tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Search CalculatorLib by keyword in any of its 12 languages — payroll, tax and social-insurance calculators for Asian markets (year-correct, legal editions cited where available) and about 8,000 general calculators. Returns the best matches (name, title, and a ready-to-use input schema) ranked by rel

tools.name: get_calculator_schema
tools.description: Full input schema (field names, types, units, options) of one calculator. Optional: search_calculators already returns a compact schema per hit.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Run a calculator and get the result. Pass the calculator's name (from search_calculators) and its input fields in args. Returns the computed values plus a share link to the calculator page with inputs pre-filled; calculators backed by a legal edition also return edition, effective_from and sources[]

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a value between units of one category (length, mass, temperature, area, volume, speed, data and 60 more). Names, symbols and common spellings work ("m", "ft", "lbs", "°C"). category is optional when the two units identify it; an unknown unit returns the category's unit list. Example: {"value

tools.name: solve_math
tools.description: Solve algebra, trigonometry or calculus step by step (equations, systems, derivatives, integrals, limits, simplify/factor). Answers are checked numerically; unverifiable problems are refused. Returns LaTeX + plain answer, steps, checks, page link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_calculator · Private data: run_calculator · Public sink: run_calculator · Destructive: run_calculator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_calculator · Private data: run_calculator · Public sink: run_calculator · Destructive: run_calculator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
